messages:
Alex K: Heads-up — noticed a p99 latency spike on main after the kernel-selection tweak this morning. Dashboard shows ~2x at 99th for chat-cpu-int8 path. Anyone else seeing this?
Priya R: saw it too. Looks correlated with sequences in 1k-2k range. p50/p90 unaffected.
Marcos L: did the rollout change the fallback ordering? I remember we moved int8 kernels earlier in the candidate list.
Alex K: yeah the policy now prefers int8 for smaller batch sizes but we widened the seq len window. Suspect int8 kernel has a pathological path for certain attention sizes.
Danielle: can we get a quick repro on staging? If we can reproduce locally I can dig into kernel traces.
bench-bot: quick-run results attached: 
```
model: redwood-3b
batch: 1
seq: 1200
tokens_out: 256
p50: 12ms
p90: 28ms
p99: 210ms  <-- regression
config: kernel_policy=v2
```
Kyle M: thanks bot. Marcos, assigning to you to check the selection logic.
Marcos L: on it. Looking at selection code — when seq>1024 we now choose fast-attn-int8 if memory_estimate < threshold. Might be mis-estimating KV cache alignment for batch=1.
Sasha: note that fused-attn path earlier had a slow path when head dim % 64 != 0; could be similar alignment issue.
Priya R: I dumped perf counters from a failing request: 
```
ATN_KERNEL=attn_int8_fast
L2_CACHE_MISS=1.8M
SM_UTIL=92%
stall_cycles=xx
```
Marcos L: those L2 misses are suspicious. If int8 kernel shifts memory access pattern, miss storm explains p99.
Danielle: suggestion — revert kernel ordering for chat workloads to previous policy while we triage. Quick rollback reduces customer impact.
Alex K: agree. Can we do a hotfix rollout to only chat endpoint?
Kyle M: we can patch routing rule in ~15min. Prepare a rollback PR and a canary.
Marcos L: meanwhile I'll add a microbench that reproduces alignment issue: script will iterate seq 1020-1300, batch 1-4, run 20 iters, collect p99 and L2 misses.
Priya R: please include both quantized and fp16 kernels in the run. We need to know if it's quantization-specific.
bench-bot: added new jobs to staging with tag: kernel-triage-177123. Results will stream to #eng-runtime/stage-bench.
Sasha: also check model compilation flags — I vaguely recall an ABI tweak for int8 matmul that changed tile sizes.
Marcos L: found quick repro locally. script attached: 
```
for seq in `seq 1020 10 1300`; do 
  ./bench --model redwood-3b --batch 1 --seq $seq --iters 30 --kernels int8,fp16
done
```
Observed p99 jump at seq=1216..1224 for int8 only. fp16 steady.
Danielle: ok good narrow range. Marcos you can open an RFC follow-up to discuss kernel fallback heuristics + alignment checks. Add an explicit alignment test in compile pipeline.
Marcos L: will do. Drafting RFC: proposed changes: 1) add mem-alignment heuristic before selecting int8 kernel; 2) prefer fp16 for seq in problematic windows; 3) add microbench stage in CI to catch p99 regressions.
Alex K: for immediate mitigation let's do Kyle's routing patch + alert on p99 delta>30% so we catch similar regressions earlier.
Kyle M: patch in PR #8421, canary to 5% in 10min. Rolling back if p99 > baseline*1.3.
Priya R: also run correctness checks — verify logits and outputs for int8 vs fp16 for those seq ranges. We don't want silent quality shrink.
Marcos L: already diffing outputs: token probs differ but top-1 stable. I'll add KL divergence numbers to the bench.
bench-bot: staging run finished: int8 p99 spike reproduced, fp16 unchanged. KL divergence < 0.01 for most steps but spikes near generation boundary. Report at /staging/bench/kernel-triage-177123.json
Sasha: sounds like a perf vs quality tradeoff — we should codify acceptable KL thresholds for rollout. Add to Optimize docs.
Danielle: action items: 
- Kyle: deploy routing rollback canary (#8421) (ETA 10m)
- Marcos: RFC + microbench + compile alignment check (ETA EOD)
- Priya: correctness diffs & KL table (ETA EOD)
- Alex: monitor console and alert thresholds (ETA 30m)

Alex K: thanks everyone. Keep replies short here, and post any new bench links. If rollback looks clean we'll ship shortly. :thumbsup:
Kyle M: canary started. Initial p99 looks back to baseline. Monitoring...
Marcos L: RFC draft posted at: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/177123-kernel-fallback (WIP)
Priya R: uploaded diffs to /artifacts/177123/int8-vs-fp16.diff.json
Danielle: good work. Let's also add an automated regression alert to per-route dashboards to prevent stealth regressions.
Alex K: noted. Closing thread after all PRs merged.
